description: A *factoring* splits the variables of a planning task into a *center* and *leaves* for decoupled search. The maximum-leaves strategy seeds one leaf per variable of a *maximum independent set* of the *causal graph* (an arc from `u` to `v` when some operator reads or writes `u` and writes `v`): a largest set of variables with no arc between any two. It grows the leaves by center variables that touch exactly one leaf, drops *frozen* leaves, and grows again; a leaf is frozen if it has no *leaf action*, an operator that changes only that leaf and reads only it and the center. It keeps the result with the most *mobile* (not frozen) leaves over the independent sets it enumerates. The result is always a *strict star*, where no arc connects two leaves.

papers.authors: Daniel Gnad, Valerie Poser, Jörg Hoffmann
papers.title: Beyond Forks: Finding and Ranking Star Factorings for Decoupled Search
papers.venue: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI)
